records.name: Viltautas
records.facts_used: Salys places Viltautas among Lithuanian two-stem names: Vil- is linked to viltis, “hope”, and Taut- to tauta, “people, nation”. These are element meanings, rather than a fixed translation of the whole name. The exact form is documented in the Senn–Salys Lithuanian–German dictionary of 1968, reprinted in Salys’s collected writings in 1983. This is a dated linguistic record of the name and its relationships; it does not identify the first child registered with this spelling.
